text: Irontree Woods lies in northern Felwood. Once a peaceful forest glade, it has been corrupted like the rest of Felwood by the demonic presence of the Burning Legion. Three Ancients - Hastat, Stoma and Vartrus, the great living trees of the night elves, have been petrified and remain permanently entombed within the Irontree Woods. Crazed treants, twisted bog beasts, ferocious wildlife, and corrupted water elementals also roam the woods, attacking any who venture near. While the Ancients are dead, life still spreads among them. When an adventurer poured moonwell water in the middle a seedling was born. After the short time taking care of it, it finally blossomed and when it was complete, it ret

Islen Waterseer is a powerful and wise tauren shaman located next to a fishing hut on the Tidus Stair in the Northern Barrens. Islen has a strong relationship with the spirits of water. Islen is also an old friend of Greta Mosshoof.

Irradiated Workers are goblins found working in the radioactive rift throughout Area 52 in Netherstorm. When a group is done, they will go to Ravandwyr for a magic show, and then to the inn for a drink where they will despawn in the doorway.
__NOTOC__ Island Shoveltusk are shoveltusks located at the Isle of Spears in the Howling Fjord.
__NOTOC__ Iruk is a tuskarr found dead in the waters between the mainland and the island in the center of Njord's Breath Bay in the Borean Tundra.
This quest starts the chain that results in the phased area of Shadow Vault becoming populated with vendors and a flight point.
The Isle of Darrow is a solitary island located in the middle of Darrowmere Lake in the Western Plaguelands. The keep of Caer Darrow is located on it.

It's Happy Hour Somewhere is an exploration achievement earned when the character has used 25 different drinks: food items that give you the 'Drink' buff without 'Eat', or food items that increase your drunkenness. The achievement's name suggests that only alcoholic drinks would count towards this achievement; however, you can quaff Ice Cold Milk or Refreshing Spring Water and it still counts for this achievement. Moonglow, although it increases your drunkenness, does not count towards this achievement.
Irva is an Aldor draenei hunter trainer located in the Terrace of Light in Shattrath City.
Isak is a goblin that appeared in a short story of Magic & Mayhem.
The Isle of Giants is an island located off the northern coast of Kun-Lai Summit and inhabited by primal devilsaurs, direhorns, and skyscreamers raised by the Zandalari trolls.

The Isle of Thunder storyline plays out in stages, tracked via the quest achievement Isle of Thunder (achievement). Much like during the Shattered Sun Offensive to retake the Isle of Quel'Danas back in Patch 2.4, completing daily quests will unlock realm-wide progress on the Isle of Thunder, gaining access to different parts of the isle.
The Isle Lion Seal can be found on the islands off the shores of Suramar.

The Isle of the Watchers is a large island in southern Azsuna. This area is contested between the Burning Legion and the wardens. It holds a few camps held by The Wardens, the surviving elite members of the Watchers. The Vault of the Wardens prison is located underneath it. Three world bosses are encountered at the isle. Withered J'im in his cave to the east, Calamir to the west and Levantus just off the northern coast.
Iroxus is an annihilan that appears at Rockaway Coast in Highmountain during Legion Assaults. He was also present at Legion Invasion locations.

Isaac Blastimov is a gnome located at Trueshot Lodge in Highmountain. He collaborated with the goblin Bamm Megabomb to build two mechanical wolves, possibly to be their combat pets: Bamm's Treble and Isaac's Rush. They were each installed with a camouflage module and on Isaac's suggestion, programmed with free will. Bamm was in charge of installing tracking units but either forgot or just never got around to it. Unfortunately, the robots decided to stealth and run away from Trueshot Lodge, and without tracking units became extremely hard to find.
Isolon Anchorite's Cudgel drops from Commander Endaxis in the Shattered Fields in Krokuun.
Irontide Lockbox Key has a chance to drop from the Seaspray murlocs on Mechagon Island.
Irradiated Bolts have a chance to drop from mobs on Mechagon Island during Ideas Can Come from Anywhere.
__NOTOC__ Isaac "Lefteye" Bentham is a worgen flight master located in Veiled Grotto in Zuldazar.
Island Pipers are sandpipers located on Tusk Isle and the Isle of Fangs in Zuldazar.
Irontide Rum Stashes are barrels found at Briny Flats in Stormsong Valley. After being destroyed, they become Smashed Barrels.
Irontide Lockboxes are chests located on Mechagon Island. They are opened with Irontide Lockbox Key.

Irradiated Undercoat is a shirt item that drops from mobs in the Reclamation Rig event on Mechagon Island. These mobs include... *Contaminated Glob *Irradiated Elemental *Neutronium Surge *and Unstable Irradiated Golem.
Irradiated Elementals are unbound earth elementals located on Mechagon Island.
Irresistible Cheese is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Irritating Moth Dust is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Island Expedition Bracers are sold by Captain Klarisa in Boralus and Captain Zen'taga in Dazar'alor for .
Island Expedition Boots are sold by Captain Klarisa in Boralus and Captain Zen'taga in Dazar'alor for .
Island Expedition Gloves are sold by Captain Klarisa in Boralus and Captain Zen'taga in Dazar'alor for .
Island Expedition Legwear is sold by Captain Klarisa in Boralus and Captain Zen'taga in Dazar'alor for .
Island Expedition Belt is sold by Captain Klarisa in Boralus and Captain Zen'taga in Dazar'alor for .
Island Expedition Cloak is sold by Captain Klarisa in Boralus and Captain Zen'taga in Dazar'alor for .

The Isle of Night is a small isle, part of the Echo Isles. Zekhan remembers this isle from his childhood, and from all the islands that make up the Echo Isles, this is his favorite. It is no bigger than a sand barge, and some Darkspears refuse to even call it an isle. It is a popular spot for many tests of courage among the Darkspear youth. There is a mighty tree at its center, and a little shrine for the bat loa, Hir'eek. Although no one remembers who built the shrine, most of the trolls still come here to leave offerings for her blessing of safe passage under the cover of darkness. According to Zekhan's grandmother, the totem is the reason for the eerie silence that hangs over the isle, br
__NOTOC__ Islefin Dorado is an uncommon fish and cooking ingredient in Dragonflight Cooking. It can only be caught in the waters of the Dragon Isles.
__NOTOC__ Irontree is a mountain giant located in a cave beneath Rusza'thar Reach in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
Island Crab Jerky is sold during the Community Feast by Tikukk in Iskaara in the Azure Span for .

JASS and JASS2 (sometimes said to stand for Just Another Scripting Syntax) is a scripting language provided with an event-driven API created by Blizzard Entertainment. It is used extensively by their games StarCraft (JASS) and Warcraft III (JASS2) for scripting events in the game world. Map creators can use it in the Warcraft III World Editor and the StarCraft Editor to create scripts for triggers and in custom maps and campaigns. JASS was replaced with Galaxy script in StarCraft II.

Item level (often abbreviated as ilevel or simply ilvl) is a rather important property of every item. It has two main functions — to reflect the item's usefulness and at the same time determine the minimum level a character must have in order to use it. Item level serves as a rough indicator of the power and usefulness of an item, designed to reflect the overall benefit of using the item. Two items of equal ilvl should in theory therefore be of equal potential use. However, each item spends its ilvl 'budget' differently, in various primary and secondary stats, as well as in procs and effects. Since each of these values provide different benefits to different classes and specs, the true value

__NOTOC__ Ithania is a blood elf who is being held in custody in North Point Tower in Dustwallow Marsh. Ithania was Balandar Brightstar's first mate on the Dawn Runner before it ran aground and she was captured. Ithania needs a rescue, but not an escort.
Ja'y Nosliw is a fel orc quest giver located at the Dragonmaw Base Camp in Shadowmoon Valley. He is friendly to players who have completed Blood Oath of the Netherwing.

The Library of Izal-Shurah (simply known as Izal-Shurah) was once a great Highborne library in the city of Suramar, but now lies in ruins on the Broken Isles. According to Maiev Shadowsong, there is no knowledge left there, only nightmares and the shadows of regret. The library had been taken over (or just moved into) by a group of makrura led by a Makrura Tidal Lord, who was found seemingly lording over a pile of seashells. Maiev could blink around to collect hidden tomes of the Ancients for her to use.
Iz'zard is an ethereal found in Shattrath City. He is speaking with Arcanist Adyria.
Ith'rix the Harvester is a nerubian flyer that appears right outside Warsong Hold in the Borean Tundra every 30 minutes. Upon death, his Ith'rix's Hardened Carapace will appear on the ground nearby.
It's Over Nine Thousand is a Feat of Strength achievement awarded for having over 9000 achievement points.

Jack Bauden is one of the top SI:7 agents employed in service to Stormwind. He was captured by the Twilight's Hammer cult after uncovering important information vital to the security of Stormwind City. He often complains that today is the longest day of his life. He appeared only in the quests The Old Barracks (quest) and Cataclysm in the Catacombs.

:This land of cloud-ringed mountains and hidden bamboo thickets runs along Pandaria's eastern shore. Horde and Alliance forces have spread out into this extraordinary locale, hoping to gain support from the ferocious hozen and industrious jinyu races that dwell throughout the Jade Forest. The Jade Forest is a zone located in eastern Pandaria, bordering the Valley of the Four Winds at the southwest and Kun-Lai Summit at the northwest. The heart of the Pandaren Empire, it is a lush rainforest with statuesque stone spires, prominent with the pandaren architecture. The Temple of the Jade Serpent is located in the eastern portion of the zone, and it is the very first dungeon adventurers will enco
Iyyokuk the Lucid is a mantid located at Klaxxi'vess. Iyyokuk is considered highly intelligent among the mantid and uses arcane magic in battle.
Jade Claw is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
__NOTOC__ Ithis Moonwarden is a night elf quest giver located in the Marshlands in eastern Un'Goro Crater.
Jade Crown can be looted from s at Moonwater Retreat in the Jade Forest.

__NOTOC__ The Jade Crane Chick is a battle pet that can be learned only by pandaren characters from the following NPC's: * in Stormwind City * in Kharanos, Dun Morogh * in Goldshire, Elwynn Forest * in Orgrimmar * in Razor Hill, Durotar * in Orgrimmar * in Lor'danel, Darkshore
Ixx is the third encounter at Rank 3 in the Brawler's Guild. Ixx has a very-wide-area cone ability that must be avoided!

It's Not Easy Being Green is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for not getting hit by Bloodvenom, Pool of Acrid Tears, or Venomous Effusion in the High Priest Venoxis encounter in Zul'Gurub on Heroic difficulty. Venoxis will only cast these abilities after transforming, starting stage two of his encounter. This occurs about 30 seconds after being engaged.
Jade Breath is an ability used by Jadefire Spirit during a Pet Battle.
The Jade Destroyer is a colossus located in Greenstone Dojo in the Greenstone Village scenario.
Ja'kana is a jungle troll flight master located at Darkspear's Edge in Frostfire Ridge. He is using his torch to warm the wyvern.
Ivory Starlings are owls found flying to the south of Dawn's Blossom in the Jade Forest.
Itara is a draenei flight master located at the Tranquil Court in .

Jace Darkweaver is a night elven demon hunter of the Illidari, initially found as a quest giver on Mardum. He used to be a mage and still retains some knowledge of the arcane, but the fel makes it near impossible to use. One thing he can still manage is the occasional spell to glimpse faraway places. Jace appears to be quite analytical and intelligent, serving as the technological brains behind the Illidari. He has shown the ability to create demonic wards and handles the maintenance and upgrades to the Illidari's Legion ship, the Fel Hammer. He can be recruited as a class order champion.
Itchin' for a Stitchin is an ability used by the Elekk Plushie during a pet battle. It forces the Plushie to swap place with the pet next in line, bringing the other pet into battle instead.
Izal Whitemoon's Coin is fished from the fountain in Dalaran at the Broken Isles.
Jacobs Rejects are sludge beast creeps found in A New Power in Lordaeron.
Ivory Hawkstrider is a hawkstrider mount reputation reward; you must be with Talon's Vengeance to purchase this item from Trinket in Highmountain for .
Jacqueline Hanswizzle is a gnome located outside the Magical Menagerie in Dalaran during the Great Gnomeregan Run alongside Joan Samfizzle and Deena Kastspindle.

Item Restoration is a free service that Blizzard offers to help restore any items that may have been vendored, disenchanted, obliterated during Legion, scrapped, or even destroyed in World of Warcraft by mistake but can only be used to restore up to fifty items once every seven days for each character.

Jacob "Jake" Felstone was a son of Emma Felstone and Jem, and the brother of James and John. All three were warriors of Lordaeron, acting as royal guards to King Terenas Menethil. They died along with their king and the kingdom during the Third War. They were raised into undeath and became Forsaken in service of Sylvanas Windrunner. Sometime after Sylvanas's sudden ascension to Warchief of the Horde, Vellcinda Benton took it upon herself to create the Desolate Council to serve as interim organization in order to lead the Undercity in the absence of the Dark Lady, as her Warchief duties brought her out of homeland. Jacob and his brothers were among the 22 Forsaken who had joined the Desolate
It's a Kind of Magic took place at the Grove of the Ancients and Twilight Vale in Darkshore during the War of the Thorns.

Izira Gearsworn is a Mechagon mechagnome located in Rustbolt on Mechagon Island. She is also encountered in Operation: Mechagon. She is one of the few survivors in an alternate future where King Mechagon succeeds in activating the Mechoriginator.
Jade-Formed Bonesnappers are quilen encountered during Island Expeditions.
Jade Barrier is an ability used by Jade Defender during a Pet Battle.
It's Not A Cult is a dungeon & raids achievement earned by defeating N'Zoth the Corruptor in Ny'alotha, the Waking City after all players have accepted the Gift of N'Zoth.
It's Not A Tumor! is an exploration achievement earned by destroying 1,000 Corruption Tumors in Uldum or Vale of Eternal Blossoms during Black Empire Assaults.
__NOTOC__ Ivan the Mad is a worgen located in Island Expeditions.

It Belongs in a Museum... Eventually concludes the Renown 24 portion of the Dragonscale Expedition storyline, and thus wraps up the patch 10.0 portion of the overarching Dragonflight campaign and likely the Friend of the Dragon Isles achievement. Up next in patch 10.0.7, the Forbidden Reach storyline!

Jadefire Run is a satyr encampment in northern Felwood. The most powerful satyr in the region make their home here, so exercise caution when adventuring in the area. The demons of Jadefire Run seemingly abandoned the area after the Cataclysm, and it was claimed by Whisperwind Healers. Feronas Sindweller, a demon hunter, was under the impression the healers were nothing more than the demons in disguise. There also appears to be more traditional demonic architecture in the Run.

Jaguero Isle is an island off the coast of Stranglethorn Vale that is populated by panthers and gorillas. Princess Poobah, a captive tauren, is kept there by an enormous ape — King Mukla. Along the coast of the Wild Shore, you will find Half-Buried Bottles. One of them will contain a Carefully Folded Note which begins the questline: * Message in a Bottle (quest) ** Message in a Bottle (2)

Jademir Lake is a medium sized lake in northern Feralas with a small island, Dream Bough, at its center. Dream Bough contains a portal to the Emerald Dream, guarded by Lethlas and several green dragonspawn. Infected green whelps can be found on the northwestern shore.
__NOTOC__ Jadenvis Seawatcher is a night elf reagent vendor located on the dock in Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.
Jailor Borhuin is a human found either in the inn or the town hall in Strahnbrad in the Alterac Mountains. Borhuin carried the key needed to free Gol'dir.
Jaina's Signet Ring is an ring. It gives bonuses to strength and stamina. This is Lady Jaina Proudmoore's ring.
Jademoon Orb is a reward for completing the quest A Grim Discovery (2) which starts with Krueg Skullsplitter at Camp Mojache in Feralas.

Jaeren Sunsworn can be found in the center of Crusaders' Coliseum. He acts as the herald for the various encounters, representing the Sunreavers. He will also occasionally spawn outside the Bank of Dalaran, on a :Sunreaver Dragonhawk, to invite players to the Argent Tournament. He starts the events in Trial of the Champion for Horde players, but is killed and raised as a ghoul by the Black Knight at the end of the instance. His Alliance equivalent is Arelas Brightstar.

Jadefire is a large tribe of satyrs in Felwood. They made Jadefire Run, Jadefire Glen and the Ruins of Constellas their home. Under the leadership of Xavaric they fed on the corruption of the local creatures and Xavathras cultivated a corrupted moonwell to bring forth more satyrs. Alshirr Banebreath belongs to this tribe, too.
Jade Tiger is a Feat of Strength rewarded for obtaining a Jade Tiger. This achievement was only given to players on Chinese realms who logged in between October 19 and November 24, 2009.

Jaina Proudmoore: Tides of War is a World of Warcraft novel by Christie Golden. Set during the period between Deathwing's defeat and Mists of Pandaria, the novel focuses on Jaina Proudmoore as Garrosh Hellscream aims to destroy Theramore.

__NOTOC__ Jahesh of Osul is the leader of the yaungol mist-shaman of the Osul tribe. Since discovering the power that draining mistlurkers can give, Jahesh led the Osul Mist-Shamans to the Upper and Lower Sumprushes to drain the tribe of mistlurkers, led by Orbiss, who dwelt there. With the help of adventurers, Orbiss, Golgoss and Arconiss assaulted and killed Jahesh at the cost of the lives of the three proud mistlurkers, ensuring the future of the Townlong Steppes mistlurkers.
This is a stationary statue created by Summon Jade Serpent Statue. It cannot be attacked or damaged in any way, and provides various boosts to a mistweaver monk's healing abilities.
Jafu Windsword is an older pandaren found in conversation with Kressu in the Shrine of Seven Stars.

Jai Maguri is a pandaren drummer in the band led by Andrea Toyas. He is usually found at the Shrine of Seven Stars but can also appear at the Halfhill Market. He also appears in the Vale of Eternal Twilight where he can be saved.
Jadeskin is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
__NOTOC__ Jake Badlands is a human flight master located at Dragon's Mouth in the Badlands.
Jafix is a goblin located at Fuselight-by-the-Sea in the Badlands. He is in charge of security and is having problems with Nik the Mountain.
Jadefire Lightning is an ability used by Yu'la, Broodling of Yu'lon during a Pet Battle.

Jale along with Tomas were guards of the Southshore prison. They were overwhelmed by Stamp Thunderhorn and his tonk. Silas Darkmoon told Professor Thaddeus Paleo to heal them but make sure they remain unconscious. It is unknown what became with him after Southshore's destruction.
Jailer's Judgment is a paladin ability temporarily gained through The Jailer's Libram, an Ashran-only drop. The spell is available for 1 hour following the use of the Libram.
Jak is a human rogue and one of the five Unethical Adventurers that appear in a cave on the Snowblind Mesa in Highmountain after a player attempts to loot the Seemingly Unguarded Treasure.
Jala Ironhorn is a Highmountain tauren located at the Orgrimmar Embassy in Orgrimmar.
__NOTOC__ Jadepyre Magi are eredar located at the Moonlight Ascent on the Broken Shore.

James "Jem" Felstone was a son of Emma Felstone and Jem. Bearing his father's name, he was the oldest of three brothers. All three were warriors of Lordaeron, acting as royal guards to King Terenas Menethil. They died along with their king and the kingdom during the Third War. They were raised into undeath and became Forsaken in service of Sylvanas Windrunner. Sometime after Sylvanas's sudden ascension to Warchief of the Horde, Vellcinda Benton took it upon herself to create the Desolate Council to serve as interim organization in order to lead the Undercity in the absence of the Dark Lady, as her Warchief duties brought her out of homeland. James and his brothers were among the 22 Forsaken

The Jambani are a group of Zandalari trolls formerly led by the witch doctor known as Vol'jamba, a former student of Prophet Zul. Vol'jamba foresaw doom for the empire, which prompted him to do everything in his power to save his people. They took control of Tal'gurub and started to stockpile rations of food. His followers also enslaved Gurubashi inhabitants and undermined Rastakhan's rule. Though they didn't know it, Vol'jamba's visions of the fall of Zuldazar were to be actually carried out by Zul himself, who had been secretly serving the Old Gods. However, Zul managed to manipulate the Speaker of the Horde into defeating Vol'jamba for him, telling them that Vol'jamba's visions were false
Jambani Wristwraps are a quest reward from Show of Strength.

Jak's Gloves drop from the Unethical Adventurers that appear at the entrance of a Snowblind Mesa cave with suspicious signage in Highmountain when a player attempts to loot the Seemingly Unguarded Treasure.
__NOTOC__ Jadeflare is a fire spirit who can be encountered during Island Expeditions.

The Jagged Coast is the longest coast on Exile's Reach, circling the entire island aside from the southeast parts. It's an isolated stretch of beach lined with cliffs and, like Jrokgar's Coast and the Murloc Hideaway, littered with shipwreck debris. No quests happen here and no mobs or NPCs are present, but there is a minor easter egg at (shown in the gallery below). The Jagged Coast continues off the north edge of the Exile's Reach map, where the terrain becomes devoid of plants and other doodads.
The Jade Jug is provided for Journey to the East. Using it teleports the player to Orchid Hollow in the Jade Forest.
Jade Ignition is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of the Jade Ignition.
Jade Skitterbug is a skitterfly companion. It does not appear to be available.

Jammal'an the Prophet is a jungle troll boss found in the Temple of Atal'Hakkar. He is accompanied by Ogom the Wretched, and must be defeated before fighting the Shade of Eranikus. Jammal'an is the spiritual leader of the great Atal'ai tribe and of the Hakkari of Zul'Gurub and Swamp of Sorrows. He believes the summoning of the blood god Hakkar the Soulflayer will bring the Atal'ai to immortality. Both the Atal'ai Exile and Itharius have asked for his head.

Jangolode Mine was one of the key sources in Westfall of minerals for Stormwind City. It was taken over by the Defias Brotherhood for a short time, however, when they were defeated the kobolds claimed the mine for themselves. During the Burning Legion's invasion, the area fell under the Legion's control. Its residents were enslaved by nathrezim and were later killed by the defenders.

__NOTOC__ Jarel Moor is a human drink vendor located in the Slaughtered Lamb in the Mage Quarter in Stormwind City. He advises patrons to "stay away from the shadows", which can't be good for business...
__NOTOC__ James Van Brunt is a Forsaken blacksmithing trainer located in the War Quarter in the Undercity.
Jekyll Flandring was a Forsaken pvp rewards vendor located outside the Alterac Valley entrance in the Alterac Mountains. He was the Frostwolf Supply Officer for the Horde.
Jeklik's Opaline Talisman is a necklace for casters that provides mana regeneration and increased damage and healing.
Jeeda is an orc reagent vendor located in Sun Rock Retreat in the Stonetalon Mountains. She is at (47.6, 61.7) upstairs in the Inn.
Jandia was a tauren trade goods vendor located in Freewind Post in Thousand Needles. She has been missing since the Shattering.

Jarkal Mossmeld is a jungle troll quest giver located in Kargath in the Badlands. He has been missing since the Cataclysm. It is presumed that he was buried beneath tons of rubble when Kargath was destroyed.

__NOTOC__ Jaycrue Copperpinch is a goblin vendor located in the Trade Quarter in the Undercity during the Feast of Winter Veil event. She is affiliated with Smokywood Pastures, and sells higher value holiday related items. Her low value counterpart is Nardstrum Copperpinch.
__NOTOC__ Jenai Starwhisper is a night elf quest giver located at Allerian Stronghold in Terokkar Forest. She is part of a network of spies who keep an eye on the ethereals in Shattrath City.
James Ormsby is the flight master located at Fort Wildervar in the contested territory of Howling Fjord.
Jelinek Sharpshear is a gnome located in the Trade District of Stormwind City. He can be found in Northshear Abbey, where he works in the employ of Genevieve. He appears in the Vision of Stormwind.

Jastor Gallywix is the former Trade Prince of the Bilgewater Cartel, one of the most powerful goblin trade guilds on Kezan. Despite betraying his own people in wake of the Cataclysm in a petty act of vengeance, he retained his position as Trade Prince of the Bilgewater Cartel for many years in its service to the Horde. Once being a vocal supporter of Garrosh Hellscream, he would eventually become one of the last leaders to support the Darkspear Rebellion, showing respect for Vol'jin and pledging his loyalty to the new Warchief following the Siege of Orgrimmar. Gallywix expresses his only desire is to find his people a secure and profitable future, which he saw neither of under Hellscream's r
__NOTOC__ James Stillair is the flight master at the Rebel Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.
Jasmine Force Tea is a Mistweaver monk ability, available at level 24.

__NOTOC__ Jasso Strongbow is a night elf found at the Shrine of Seven Stars, standing near Soignera Strongbow. He volunteered to protect the Sapling of Lore. After the defilement of the Vale, he moved before the Shrine.
Jaul Hsu is a pandaren located at the Shrine of Seven Stars.
Jamin is a human found fishing at Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains.
__NOTOC__ Jaslyn Moongazer is a night elf food and drink vendor located at Lion's Watch in Tanaan Jungle. She can be found beside the series of tents near the center of the outpost.

Jarud is a tauren or draenei (depending on the race of the player) warrior that is a part of the Uber Town group. He can be briefly seen during the flashback of the confrontation with Illidan Stormrage atop the Black Temple.
Jana Winterhoof is a tauren alchemist located in Thunder Bluff. During the feast for the Highmountain tauren, she was trapped by the Void.

__NOTOC__ Jarvox is a fel lord located in Azsuna. After the Highlord peers into the Legion Orbs, the dreadlord Balnazzar warns Jarvox that the enemy is nearby. Balnazzar tells him to protect the Codex of Command to his hearts content and teleports away. Jarvox tells the paladins that one of their own is being held captive and is rescued by the Highlord as well as being defeated by them.
Jaws of the Mongoose is a Survival hunter artifact trait. It is linked to the Ferocity of the Unseen Path and Talon Bond traits.
Jeeru is a djinn druid featured in the Kobolds & Catacombs expansion for Hearthstone. She has the ability to grant wishes.
Jar of Smelly Liquid is an ability used by battle pets during a Pet Battle.
The Jarmouthed Goby is fished from the waters around Mechagon Island.

Jon-Jon Jellyneck leads an unnamed tribe of jungle trolls that make their home within the Twilight Highlands. The tribe has a host of wyverns that they use, which is why they were contracted by Lady Cozwynn to aid with destroying the local Twilight's Hammer operations. They may live on the shore of the region, as Jon-Jon claims he has a house there with his "lady", inviting the Horde adventurer to stop by when they are finished.
Jamie Gearknock is a Mechagon mechagnome located in Rustbolt on Mechagon Island.

__NOTOC__ Janius was a night elf boy from Ara-Hinam and a childhood friend of Shandris Feathermoon prior to the War of the Ancients. By the time of the Nazjatar Campaign, his ghost was found in Nazjatar. Shandris searched for him, leading to her putting him to rest. As she did, Janius turned into a wisp.
The Jenafur is a cat companion pet. It belongs to Amara Lunastar. Acquire the cat by petting Jenafur in the Opera Hall of Return to Karazhan. See the Riddle of Jenafur for more information.

Jay Gibone is a level 3 undead creep that appears on an island north of a random archmage hero near a tent in the mission Under the Burning Sky from the Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos undead campaign, Path of the Damned. He was added in Warcraft III: Reforged and drops no items when killed. It is currently unknown if the name is a reference to something or someone related to Reforged.
Jason Trost is a Forsaken participating in the Darkmoon Faire dancing contest.
Janatak is a tuskarr flight master located at Uktulut Backwater in the Waking Shores.

__NOTOC__ Jessir Moonbow is a night elf quest giver currently located in Wildheart Point in Felwood along with a few other members of the Emerald Circle. Before the Cataclysm, she was located at the Emerald Sanctuary. She sought her friends Arko'narin and Trey Lightforge, who had traveled here to investigate the resurgence of the Shadow Council.

Jin'do the Hexxer is a jungle troll witch doctor boss inside Zul'Gurub. He is not considered a High Priest and does not give Hakkar the Soulflayer any specific abilities; however, many players consider him the hardest boss inside Zul'Gurub.

Jerod's Landing is a boat landing on the Elwynn Forest bank of the Nazferiti river. The landing has recently been taken over by the Defias Brotherhood, and they use it to smuggle stolen goods from Redridge Mountains to Klaven's Tower in Westfall. It is run by the Dockmaster. The entire region near Jerod's Landing is crawling with Defias rogues and bandits, making it quite hazardous to cross through for inexperienced adventurers.

The characters Jesseriah McCree, Jessup McCree, Marshal McCree, Jenny McCree and Jessera of Mac'Aree (and, by extension, the city of Mac'Aree) are all likely references to him. Joel Thomson is the son of Thomas and Suzannah Thomson. At her husband's urgings, Suzannah tried to bring herself and her children to the distant land of Kalimdor in order to escape the undead Scourge. However complications prevented them from leaving. Thomas, the future Headless Horseman, would come to the conclusion that a storm destroyed the last ship fleeing to Kalimdor. In time, the Thomson's hiding spot from the undead would come under attack by the paranoid and zealous humans of the Scarlet Crusade. Ironically enough the one to kill Joel, his mother and his sister would be his own father, who wouldn't recognize them until it was too late.
Jorgensen's Cage Key drops from Utroka the Keymistress in the Redridge Mountains.

The jinyu are a race of humanoid fish-like creatures that live in Pandaria. They are an elder and wise race, looked up to even by the pandaren. Masters of the water, they have been known to stick their staves in rivers and literally hear what the land is saying. The waterspeakers are an upper caste, spiritual leaders that use the river to listen to the future. The ankoan are descended from jinyu who left Pandaria long ago to hunt in the depths of the oceans.

The Joining the Alliance quest is the first quest pandaren players receive upon arriving Stormwind City, after choosing to join the Alliance at the end of the Wandering Isle storyline, in which the player, accompanied by Aysa Cloudsinger, has to speak to King Anduin Wrynn in Stormwind Keep. The equivalent for players that have chosen to join the Horde is Joining the Horde.

Jogu the Drunk is a jinyu and a member of the Tillers. Unlike the other members, Jogu's residence is not a farm or any kind of building, but at the edge of Halfhill Market's watering hole. Despite this and his near-constant inebriation, he is a valuable member of the Tillers due to his ability to predict what crops will grow best on any given day.
Jo the Wind Watcher is a pandaren flight master located in Binan Village in Kun-Lai Summit.

When the Thunder King began to see all other races within his domain as servants, he launched a brutal campaign against the jinyu. Though they fought valiantly, the fish-men eventually crumbled before the might of Lei Shen. During one battle, the mogu fought against the jinyu empire in a battle that lasted forty days and forty nights. He and his followers experimented with forbidden blood magic derived from Hakkar the Soulflayer. Following Gurubashi raids on human villages in Westfall, the three friends Prince Llane Wrynn, Medivh and Anduin Lothar infiltrated Stranglethorn with the intent of quickly killing Jok'non in his ziggurat and then retreating, leaving the trolls without a leader. However, their plan was anything but flawless. When battle erupted, it attracted a tremendous amount of attention, and the three humans soon found themselves in a brutal fight for their lives. __NOTOC__ Judgement of Light is one of three Judgment abilities available to paladins. In addition to a seal's Judgement effect, it gives melee attacks against the target a chance to heal the attacker.

Judgement of Wisdom is a Paladin ability that places a Judgment on the enemy target, causing attackers to restore their mana. It replaced the Judgement effect of Seal of Wisdom. As with all Judgements, your miss chance with Judgement of Wisdom is the same as your miss chance with a melee attack.

Judgement of Justice is a Paladin ability. It replaced the Judgement effect of Seal of Justice. It is trainable at level 28. As with all Judgements, your Miss chance with Judgement of Justice is the same as your miss chance with a melee attack.

Jotunheim is the largest vrykul village in Northrend, located on the northwestern cliffs of Icecrown. It is the place where the vrykul were first reawakened from their magical sleep and is the second-most important place to them, the first being Ymirheim. The village is a string of buildings that winds along the cliff tops over the North Sea and culminates at Balargarde Fortress, a place that tries to put Utgarde Keep to shame in size and number of decorative skulls. It is well fortified against attacks, and even has aerial defenses. One end of Jotunheim features a challenge pit, named the pit of Valhalas, which is decorated by wooden dragon heads and overseen by a val'kyr named Geirrvif. In
"Journal of Archmage Antonidas" is a book in Dalaran written by the former leader of the Kirin Tor, the archmage Antonidas. The journal can spawn in place of The Schools of Arcane Magic.

Judgements of the Pure is a talent in the Holy paladin tree. It causes your Judgments to grant a buff that increases your haste in both casting and melee by 3/6/9%, and increases your mana regeneration from Spirit while in combat by 10/20/30%. The buff lasts 1 minute.

His cellar was used as an arsenal by the Northgate rebels.

Joyland (also called World Joyland) is a future theme park with as theme Blizzard's games, located in China's Wunjin District. The company building Joyland, CCJoy, does not appear to have any official affiliation with Activision Blizzard or WoW, and Blizzard has apparently not given its consent for the construction of the park. Apparently, the park is going to be divided in a few sub-area's, including 'Terrain of Warcraft', 'Moles World' and 'The Island of My story'.
Judgments of the Bold is a passive Retribution paladin ability, available at level 28.
Jorunga Stonehoof is a tauren blacksmith found in the Chamber of Masters in the Shrine of Two Moons. He supplies, trains, and provides new plans for other blacksmiths.

Jovite Ore is a teal-colored metal native to . It's considered an excellent material for blacksmithing, and some of the best quality material was reliably sourced from Kuuro's Claim, a mine in Talador. The mountain that Gordal Fortress sits upon is also full of jovite, enough that the Gordunni ogres have begun trading the jovite to the Iron Horde. To purify jovite into high quality metal, a strong flux is required.
Jug of Drog is sold by Sakrul the Brewbrul at the upper level of Thunder Totem in Highmountain.

The Jotunheim vrykul are a conglomerate of vrykul living in the same area, Jotunheim. The Thanes are constantly at war between them. The exact relation between the Mjordin and the Jotunheim vrykul is unclear. They share the cliff city of Jotunheim and the Balargarde Fortress but there was no evidence to link them directly.

Jrob Hammersmack is a Mechagon mechagnome located on Mechagon Island.

Juho was a Zandalari troll lieutenant who fought against the Widow's Bite and the Banshee loyalists in Nazmir. He initially viewed the conflict as fighting for Bwonsamdi, but Zekhan reminded how the rebels were stealing trolls from their bed and sacrificing them for dark magics. When Juho saw that their enemies were prepared to sacrifice children, he was horrified and ordered the Zandalari to attack them. His fate after this skirmish is unknown.

Julk is a tuskarr located in Khuri's Fishing Spot in the Azure Span. She is seen speaking with Miva Star-Eye.

Jungle trolls are a troll subgroup, mainly found in Stranglethorn Vale. The jungle trolls as a whole are also referred to as Gurubashi, after the ancient empire of the same name, but that name can also refer to the Gurubashi tribe in particular. Their capital, Zul'Gurub, is located in Stranglethorn Vale, along with many smaller towns, cities, and villages, many of which are in a state of ruin or disrepair. The largest jungle troll settlement outside Stranglethorn is Echo Isles — founded by the Darkspear tribe. Jyn Stonehoof is a tauren weapons vendor located on the lower rise in Thunder Bluff. She is a member of the Stonehoof tribe. During the feast for the Highmountain tauren, she was trapped by the Void.
The Jutebraid Gloves are cloth gloves that give a bonus to strength and intellect.

__NOTOC__ Jungle Thunderers are gorillas found in Stranglethorn Vale. When a Jungle Thunderer was tamed by a hunter it taught Thunderstomp (pet ability) Rank 1. Thunderstomp Rank 1 would require 15 points to train your other pets.

Each murloc tribe has at least one village and K's'litain houses the White Shark tribe. The White Sharks live along the southwestern edge of the Howling Fjord in Northrend, and it is the tribe closest to Valgarde. K's'litain is the easternmost village and is less than two days' run from Valgarde itself. As with all murlocs, the White Shark tribe is religious. They worship the Deep Mother, the water, and her favored children. Shamans rule the village, dictating who handles which chores and what must be done from day to day. Justin Boehm is a crewman of the Assurance found in Stormwind Harbor of Stormwind City.

Just Maces is a weapons shop located in Stormwind City's Cathedral Square. The shop is owned and run by Gregory Ardus and, despite its name, sells a wide range of melee weapons. The shop can be found just south-west of the Cathedral of Light.

Jungle Cats are panthers initially encountered in the area immediately surrounding the Horde Base Camp on the Lost Isles. They can be found in the higher elevations of the smaller island. They can be seen attacking frogs.
